messages:
Junaid: Quick ping — we have a candidate for SWE II on Wed 10:00am PT. need someone to own system-design panel start in case @Elena is late.
Elena: Heads-up I might be ~15m late that morning, I can take the back half if someone can start and hand off.
Maya: I can start at 10:00 and hand off at 10:30. quick Q — which rubric version are we using for design vs infra? last time prod-readiness weight confused a couple panelists.
Rebecca: we should use SWE-II rubric v2 (weights: design 40, infra 30, culture 30). link in hiring drive; pinged people-ops to confirm recording checklist.
people-ops-bot: checklist reminder — please confirm candidate recording consent, update Greenhouse with panelist names, and assign a debrief note owner (defaults to panel lead).
Maya: can someone drop the rubric link here? also do we still normalize scores across panels or only during daily calibration?
Rebecca: link: https://drive.redwood.example/hiring/rubrics/SWE-II-v2
Rebecca: we normalize if there are multiple panels same day; otherwise leave raw and calibrate in the debrief sync.
Junaid: @Maya can you add yourself as panel lead in Greenhouse and own the debrief? I'll add a calendar handoff note at 10:30.
Maya: done — added myself as lead and updated the invite with handoff note + video tag.
Elena: can you paste two anchor questions for the infra-focused 10:30-10:50 so I can prep?
Maya: sure: 1) Walk me through a recent system you helped scale — focus on design choices and tradeoffs. 2) How would you roll back a schema change with minimal downtime?
Elena: perfect, I'll lean into infra depth and ops tradeoffs.
Rebecca: tiny ops ask — please create a single debrief doc (template in drive). paste scores with 1-2 rationale bullets each; makes hiring committee review easier.
Maya: will do, I'll post the debrief doc link after the interview. calendar snippet I'm adding below for reuse:
```
Panel start 10:00 PT — intro + behavioral (10m)
Design deep-dive 10:10-10:30 (Maya)
Handoff at 10:30
Infra + ops follow-up 10:30-10:50 (Elena)
Debrief: create GH note and add scores within 2h
```
Rebecca: :thumbsup: tagging @people-ops to confirm recording consent step.
people-ops-bot: recording consent requested — candidate responded YES at 2024-11-02T09:12:03Z. please proceed.
Junaid: Thanks all — covered. Closing loop here.
Maya: ack, will post debrief doc after.
Elena: I'll join at ~10:25 to warm up and take over at 10:30.
